qa.q: Rory, have you ever had a pet?
qa.a: Yeah, our family had a tradition of keeping Chow Chows. That's a breed of dog from China. That's one of the seven ancient breeds, actually, I think. And we also had fish, stick insects, and an assortment of other small creatures from the local area that my little brother and I picked up. We don't have them now, but we did before when we were younger.

qa.q: Do you have a pet at home now?
qa.a: No, I live in a rented and shared apartment, so that wouldn't be fair and I haven't the time to look after another animal, to be honest with you. I would like a dog though, when I have a family of my own. I think it's helpful for kids to have a pet to help them learn about the world and cope with the struggles it brings.

qa.q: What kind of pets do you like?
qa.a: Well, I like dogs. If anyone has a dog, they have immediately won me over. Specifically, big dogs, though I like dogs in general too. They're they're really welcoming and they create this air of warmth in a household, which is really nice to have.

qa.q: Did you have any pets when you were a child?
qa.a: Like I said, we had two of man's best friend, and numerous goldfish and small creatures. I think it helped a lot growing up to have companions, though I should have appreciated it more at the time. I don't think you ever do when you're a child.

qa.q: What kinds of pets are common in your country?
qa.a: Well, at the risk of flogging a dead horse in terms of topics, dogs are very popular. You can see them everywhere. Cats are also a common sight in our neighborhood and the surrounding neighborhoods as well, as are fish, although the fish will be outside and in their fish tanks. I heard that people are increasingly keeping ducks, but I'm not sure if that's true or not.

qa.q: Why do some people keep pets at home?
qa.a: Well, they're good company and they add to the general ambiance of the place. And they serve as a sort of furry security force. There are lots of other uses. I think companionship is the main desire they cater to though. Animals are really good company to have.
